subject: Sentry Bank onboarding — MAP & security checkpoints
messages:
From: Alex Morton <alex.morton@sentrybank.com>
To: Diego Fernández <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sentry Bank Legal <legal@sentrybank.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Sentry Bank onboarding — MAP & security checkpoints

Diego,

Thanks for the intro earlier. We're preparing our vendor onboarding packet and want to align on a mutual action plan (MAP) and the security gates that need to be cleared before legal signs the DPA. High-level asks from our side:
- SOC 2 Type II report / AOC availability
- SIG/CAIQ questionnaire completed or an assessed CAIQ export
- Proposed DPA redline (we prefer a 7-year retention window for certain logs)
- A short timeline to close (we'd like to be live by 2026-12-20)

Can you send a MAP with milestones and who will own each deliverable? Also attach any evidence bundles you can share early.

Appreciate it — can we target a check-in early next week?

Alex
Head of Risk & Vendor Management
Sentry Bank
From: Diego Fernández <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morton <alex.morton@sentrybank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sentry Bank onboarding — MAP & security checkpoints

Alex — thanks, great to see the priorities laid out. Attached is an initial MAP (MAP_SentryBank_v1.xlsx) with milestones, owners, and target dates. Quick summary below: 

Milestone 1 — Evidence intake (SOC2 AOC, CAIQ export)
Owner: Camila Reyes (Security)
Target: 2026-11-27

Milestone 2 — DPA redline review (legal)
Owner: Laura Bennett (Legal)
Target: 2026-11-30

Milestone 3 — SIG/CAIQ deep-dive and Q&A
Owner: Camila
Target: 2026-12-02

Milestone 4 — Final MAP sign-off & DocuSign
Owner: Diego / Alex
Target: 2026-12-07

Close target (Go-live): 2026-12-20 (per your note) — we will flag any blockers early.

Attachments included here: Redwood_SOC2_AOC_2026.pdf (SOC 2 AOC), SentryBank_SIG_CAICQ_Questions.xlsx (template return sheet), DPA_redline_v1.docx (our starting redline).

Quick notes on retention: Laura will propose acceptable retention windows — we typically offer a range depending on data class; we'll surface options in our DPA redline so you can pick the one that aligns with your controls. If a 7-year retention requirement is non-negotiable, please flag it and we'll escalate.

Camila, first pass on CAIQ and AOC please — can you confirm what we can share by EOD Wednesday?

Diego
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernández <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Alex Morton <alex.morton@sentrybank.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sentry Bank onboarding — MAP & security checkpoints

Alex / team — looping in legal notes on retention and the DPA approach. Key items we will include in DPA_redline_v1.docx: 
- Data retention tiers (operational logs: 90 days; analytics/metrics: 3 years; regulated transaction data: configurable by customer; we propose 3 years by default with a customer option to extend)
- Export & deletion procedures and certified deletion timeline
- Audit logs and access reviews cadence

If Sentry Bank requires a mandatory 7-year retention for specific classes, we need explicit account-level controls and proof of business requirement (legal/regulatory). Please confirm which data classes you mean (e.g., transaction-level PII vs aggregated metrics). Once we have that, I can produce a DPA redline that includes the extension and any associated security compensating controls.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Morton <alex.morton@sentrybank.com>
To: Diego Fernández <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Sentry Bank Legal <legal@sentrybank.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 07:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sentry Bank onboarding — MAP & security checkpoints

Thanks, Diego / Laura.

Good plan — Sentry Bank would need a 7-year retention for transaction audit trails (regulatory requirement for a specific product line). We'll send the formal requirement language this afternoon so you can include it in the DPA redline. Two operational asks from our side: 
- Can SIG/CAIQ be completed (answers + attachments) by 2026-12-02? We use that for our internal risk scoring.
- Can we get the SOC 2 AOC and the log retention controls section highlighted so our reviewers can find them quickly?

If those two items land on schedule I think we can keep to the MAP dates and aim to sign by 2026-12-07.

Alex
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernández <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Morton <alex.morton@sentrybank.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sentry Bank onboarding — MAP & security checkpoints

Quick update — Camila here from Security. Plan and status: 
- SOC 2 AOC: Redwood_SOC2_AOC_2026.pdf attached — I highlighted the sections on logging + monitoring and vendor management.
- SIG/CAIQ: I'll return the spreadsheet (SentryBank_SIG_CAICQ_Questions.xlsx) with answers and evidence links by 2026-12-02. Any items we can't fully answer we'll mark as "planned" with expected remediation dates.
- DPA retention: Laura — I can document the compensating security controls (WORM logs, restricted access, annual retention review) to accompany any 7-year ask.

I'll start populating the MAP worksheet and will ping stakeholders if any evidence needs to be redacted.

Camila Reyes
Security Manager, Redwood Inference
